parents.name: Fisher-KPP equation (with diffusion and logistic growth)
parents.term_mapping: parent diffusion D u_xx === discovered 0.1 u_xx (coefficient D=0.1); parent logistic r u(1-u) === discovered 1.0 u(1-u) (coefficient r=1.0); added term: transport term -0.5 ∂_x[u(1-u) cos(x)] which is not present in Fisher-KPP.
parents.symbol_roles: u is a population density or concentration (0<u<1); D is diffusivity, r is intrinsic growth rate.

parents.name: Reaction-diffusion equation with non-Fickian advection
parents.term_mapping: the diffusion term matches a linear diffusivity D=0.1; logistic term matches reaction f(u)=u(1-u); added/modified term: the flux -0.5 u(1-u) cos(x) is an added advection-like flux (not diffusive in gradient).
parents.symbol_roles: u: concentration or density; D(u): diffusion coefficient; f(u): source/sink; g: space-dependent flux vector.

parents.name: Cahn-Hilliard type equation with nonlinear phase separation and external potential
parents.term_mapping: discovered equation has ∇·[flux] where flux is -0.5 u(1-u) cos(x) — resembles a Cahn-Hilliard flux with concentration-dependent mobility and a sinusoidal potential; but the second derivative is exactly linear (no fourth-order term) so the parent is heavily modified.
parents.symbol_roles: u: phase field (0↔1); M(u): mobility; μ(u): chemical potential; λ: gradient energy coefficient.

parents.name: Anisotropic diffusion with drift in a periodic potential
parents.term_mapping: the diffusion term matches D=0.1 constant; transport term -0.5 ∂_x[u(1-u)cos(x)] is a drift with velocity v(x,u)=0.5(1-u)cos(x); logistic term is an extra source.
parents.symbol_roles: u: particle density or concentration; D: diffusion constant; v: drift velocity due to external potential.

parents.name: Keller-Segel type chemotaxis model (with logistic growth)
parents.term_mapping: the diffusion term matches D=0.1; the logistic term matches r=1.0; the transport term -0.5 ∇·[u(1-u) cos(x)] is a modified chemotactic flux where χ∇φ is replaced by 0.5(1-u)cos(x) (so the advection velocity depends on local carrying capacity and the chemical gradient is sinusoidal).
parents.symbol_roles: u: cell density; D: random motility; χ: chemotactic sensitivity; φ: chemical concentration; r: growth rate.

parents.name: Reaction-convection-diffusion (population with directed movement)
parents.term_mapping: parent has advection ∇·(v u); discovered has flux -0.5 u(1-u)cos(x) so v = -0.5(1-u)cos(x) (an added density-dependent drift); diffusion and logistic carried over; no other terms.
parents.symbol_roles: u: population density; v: velocity field (may depend on u and x); D: diffusion; f: birth/death.
